answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 1906 Country: Pakistan Title: Is it permissible to give zakat to servants of mosques? Question: Is it permissible to give zakat to servants of mosques? Answer ID: 1906 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 670/665=D) The servants of mosque, if they are poor, not owning nisab and are not from Syed family, can be given zakat money provided it is not a compensation of their service or as salary. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
